title: 作品先行
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a high fidelity MOBILE HOMEPAGE design comp, one flat, straight-on long browser page at 1024 x 2816 pixels, no device bezel, no surrounding presentation board. It must look like a real designed Chinese mobile web storefront, not a poster. The visitor is a beginner choosing a finished crochet idea, then finding its material kit.
Reference image: the provided actual existing homepage screenshot carries the approved visual identity ONLY: warm nearly-white paper #f7f7f5, warm white #fffefa, charcoal #2f302f, blush #faecea, pale blue #edf5f7, mint #edf4ee, cream #fff6df, butter #f8e5a9; fine monoline icons, soft paper shadows, Noto Sans SC/PingFang-like Chinese sans type. Preserve this world and the reference's hero language. DO NOT reproduce its redundant navigation strip, big yellow browse button, separate shawl headline or giant marketing blocks. No new brand system, no dark section, no saturated colors, no serif type, no handwritten headings.
Shared exact top composition: compact header with three-line menu left, centered pastel Chinese wordmark, search and cart icons right. Below: left aligned bold two-line main headline, small supporting paragraph; right cropped original ivory crochet granny squares in blush mint and butter plus a peach yarn ball, very subtle fine grid paper and a few taupe stitch symbols. Reduce hero height so it does not dominate. A single white three-step strip partly overlaps its bottom, showing the existing three fine monoline round illustrations (choosing a motif, yarn in basket, hands crocheting), thin arrows between. The entire top including this strip occupies about 34 percent of the canvas, consistently across variants.
Then ONE continuous discovery area, not a parade of isolated marketing cards. No huge seasonal section, no hero for a single shawl, no separate auxiliary four-icon navigation, no standalone browse CTA. Show real content shape using four original illustrative finished crochet photos: mint/ivory drawstring bag; blue-to-pink lace triangular shawl; pale rainbow wave blanket; dusty blush ruffled shoulder bag. All four product photographs have consistent soft daylight, warm-white/pastel grounds, no watermark, no printed labels. They are generated sample illustrations for composition, NOT real product photos. Include the disclosure specified below legibly. Use no prices, ratings, sales counts, difficulty levels, completion times, availability or tutorial claims.
Every product entry includes its short name, a small label identifying it as a kit, and a quiet text-arrow action to see materials. Never use cart/add icons on the work-result cards.
At the very bottom a compact pale-blue help area, simple yarn/question monoline icon, short heading and text link; not another giant card.
Include a clearly OPEN custom season dropdown anchored to its control in the discovery toolbar: warm-white panel, thin warm-gray border, 14px-equivalent corners, soft shadow; three full-height readable options with first option selected in pale blush with a charcoal check. Leave result titles readable. This is a web popover in the brand system, not an OS/native select screenshot. Do not draw other open menus.
All visible readable text must be ONLY the following exact Simplified Chinese strings, repeated only where specified as reusable labels. NO JAPANESE, no kana, no Latin letters, no random text, no misspellings, no extra headings or labels. Do not print any prompt instructions, variant letters, hex colors or pixel measurements.
Exact text inventory by role:
1. Header wordmark: "毛线工作室"
2. Hero headline first line: "先选喜欢的作品，"
3. Hero headline second line: "选线交给我们。"
4. Hero paragraph: "从想做的作品出发，找到合适的毛线与套件。购买前，先确认材料用量和教程。"
5. Three step labels, left to right: "选择作品" ; "购买材料" ; "开始制作"
6. Discovery heading: "你想做什么？"
7. Search placeholder: "搜索想做的作品"
8. Four category labels: "包袋" ; "围巾与披肩" ; "毯子" ; "玩偶"
9. Content type tabs: "作品套件" ; "毛线" ; "工具"
10. Three filter controls: "全部用量" ; "季节" ; "全部风格"
11. Open season menu options, top to bottom: "不限季节" ; "春夏" ; "秋冬"
12. Four product titles, reading order: "淡彩抽绳包" ; "花火镂空披肩" ; "渐变波纹毯" ; "荷叶边肩背包"
13. Reusable label once per product: "材料套件"
14. Reusable text action once per product: "查看材料"
15. Help heading: "选材料拿不准？"
16. Help action: "问问我们"
17. Small but readable disclosure under discovery heading: "内部视觉示意，非实际商品图"
Typography must be pixel sharp and clean. Body minimum apparent 14px at 390px mobile width. Keep generous internal spacing but do not insert blank spacer sections. Render the completed surface from top to bottom within the frame.

Variant structure: PHOTOGRAPH-FIRST EXPLORATION. After the shared top, put discovery heading and disclosure, then a full-width search field. Replace the large atlas rectangles with one light compact horizontal row of four small stitch-symbol icons above their category labels, each icon on a small blush/blue/mint/cream circle, a single continuous row without bordered cards. Under it place the three type tabs and then the filter pills. Keep this control stack genuinely compact so completed works appear much earlier and larger than variant A. Use a two-column open gallery of the same four finished works, with taller portrait 4:5 photos and larger breathing room around the work itself. Names, kit label and text-arrow action below each photograph remain modest and consistent. The open season popover is anchored to the middle filter and floats over the top-right image corner without obscuring titles. The dominant mechanism is seeing several things one could make before needing detailed yarn knowledge. No masonry, no giant featured item, no favorites.
